# Jieyuan Pei — research resources

> Academic website and linked research artifacts.

## Profile
- [Academic homepage](https://guobapei.github.io/): Biography and publications.

## SuperGlance (arXiv 2026)
- [SuperGlance project page](https://guobapei.github.io/SuperGlance/): Video, method and results; a vision-language model that plans in one forward pass and still answers questions.
- [SuperGlance paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19138): arXiv:2611.19138.
- [SuperGlance code](https://github.com/GuobaPei/SuperGlance): Training and evaluation code.

## Hyperbolic Neural Operator (ICML 2026)
- [HNO research resources](https://guobapei.github.io/Hyperbolic-Neural-Operator/llms.txt): Paper, full text, code, benchmark summary and citation.
- [HNO abstract and results](https://guobapei.github.io/Hyperbolic-Neural-Operator/paper.html): Lorentz-distance attention for multiscale PDE surrogate modeling.
- [HNO paper PDF](https://guobapei.github.io/Hyperbolic-Neural-Operator/assets/paper.pdf): Complete author-provided manuscript.
